items.author: cyborgurl.bsky.social
items.context:
REDDER trivia: REDDER began as a sort of reimagining of the 1991 dos platformer Monuments of Mars by Todd Replogle before it turned into the thing it is. as such, there's a discarded (but playable!) attempt at a tutorializing "Level 1" in the prototype pack you can unlock by paying for the game
quotes @cyborgurl.bsky.social: "Metroid if it had been created by Stanley Kubrick." REDDER is back.
items.text: Nice bit of lineage. Monuments of Mars is a fun DOS deep cut.
